content_sections.heading: About NHM Vellore
content_sections.text: Vellore District Health Society is the district body of the National Health Mission in Tamil Nadu, with its office at the District Collectorate Complex, Sathuvachari, Vellore. The posts are for Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) institutions, including Special Newborn Care Units (SNCU) and Pediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU), under the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Directorate of Medical Education & Research.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice gives the total number of vacancies in the Vellore district as 63. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The age limit is up to 50 years for all three posts. The notice does not mention an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

rows.qualification: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from Government Institutions or Government-approved Private Nursing College with a Valid Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.
MBBS degree with a Valid Registration with the Tamil Nadu Medical Council.
Pass in the Higher Secondary School Examination and one/two years ANM course conducted from DME/DPH approved institution with a Valid Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse: Rs. 21,000/- per month. Medical Officer: Rs. 63,000/- per month. Urban Health Nurse: Rs. 17,500/- per month. The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and shall not confer any right to claim regularisation. Selection and engagement shall be as per G.O. (Ms.) No. 427, Health and Family Welfare (EAP-II/1) Department, dated 18.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Vellore Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form and vacancy details from the District Official website, https://vellore.nic.in . Fill in the application form. Attach photocopies of the relevant documents. Send the application so that it reaches the following address on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM: The District Health Officer / Executive Secretary (District Health Society), District Health Office, 2nd Floor, B – Block, District Collectorate Complex, Sathuvachari, Vellore – 9. The notice does not state how the application is to be sent (post or by hand).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the relevant documents, enclosed with the filled application form. The notice does not list the documents individually.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NHM Vellore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 63 vacancies in Vellore district: 54 Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, 3 Medical Officer and 6 Urban Health Nurse.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Health Office, Vellore on or before 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from Government Institutions or a Government-approved Private Nursing College, with a valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Medical Officer and Urban Health Nurse?
faq.answer: Medical Officer needs an MBBS degree with a valid Tamil Nadu Medical Council registration. Urban Health Nurse needs a pass in the Higher Secondary School Examination and a one/two years ANM course from a DME/DPH approved institution, with a valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: Staff Nurse gets Rs. 21,000/- per month, Medical Officer Rs. 63,000/- per month and Urban Health Nurse Rs. 17,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NHM Vellore recruitment?
faq.answer: Download the application form from https://vellore.nic.in, fill it in, attach photocopies of the relevant documents and make sure it reaches the District Health Officer / Executive Secretary (District Health Society), District Health Office, 2nd Floor, B – Block, District Collectorate Complex, Sathuvachari, Vellore – 9 by 04.12.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and does not confer any right to claim regularisation.

faq.question: Q9. Under which order are selection and engagement made?
faq.answer: Selection and engagement shall be as per G.O. (Ms.) No. 427, Health and Family Welfare (EAP-II/1) Department, dated 18.11.2026.
